summary.datum: 2,300 m subsea; gauge-to-datum at 10.5 kPa/m (IHS reservoir gradient); KBs TEC-2 3.8, TEC-6 6.0, TEC-7 4.8, TEC-10 6.13 m
summary.initial: 24 May 1956 TEC-2: 252.0 kg/cm2 at 2,310 mKB after 2 h 45 min = 24.65 MPa (3,575 psia) at datum
summary.latest: 2018: three wells 24.14-24.16 MPa (3,500-3,505 psia) at datum (TEC-2 static gradient 27 Mar; TEC-2 p* 30 May; TEC-10 p* 31 Aug)
summary.change: -0.51 MPa (-74 psi, ~2 %) over 62 years and ~1.9-2.1 MMbbl of oil; expansion alone would supply ~11 kbbl, so >99 % of voidage replaced by water influx (docs/05_pressure.md §3)
summary.stabilised_static_range: 24.14-24.66 MPa for every survey with >= 1 week shut-in, 1964-2018
exceptions: 1971 TEC-6 build-up: 23.24 MPa after 4 days rising to 24.35 MPa after 74 days - short shut-ins understate by up to ~1 MPa (the review's 23.2 MPa low end is this 4-day point)
Flowing surveys: TEC-6 1964 (18.66 MPa datum) and 1973 (22.68 MPa, mislabelled static in the Work Program); TEC-2 1956 flowing 234.2 kg/cm2; 2018 BHFP TEC-2 16.8, TEC-10 21.3 MPa
TEC-3 1956 DST 230 kg/cm2 after 10 min at ~2,372 mSS: not stabilised, no datum value
TEC-7 Dec 1964: date (8 vs 12 Dec) and value (252.0 vs 251.90 kg/cm2) differ between the IFR summary and the expediente
TEC-6 12 Aug 1971: 248.0 (IFR) vs 246.7 kg/cm2 (CNH table), G-73; 9 Aug 1971 corrected 248.0 -> 244.6 from the scan (G-51)
2017 'Psr 25.1-25.4 MPa' has no datum and should not be plotted
No pressure measurement exists after Aug 2018; the field has been shut in since Jan 2023 (a long-shut-in static on TEC-10 is the recommended next measurement)
